title: Metric Mix-Ups Left A Plane With Less Than Half Its Fuel
hook: A metric mix-up left an airliner carrying just 20,400 pounds of fuel.
closing: A number without its unit can turn a routine calculation into a dangerous mistake.
question: Where have mixed units caused you trouble?

segments.say: The dataset's non-metric country group contains 5% of the world's population. Unit systems remain uneven across borders.
The orbiter's actual altitude was 57 kilometers in the supplied comparison. A unit mismatch sent it much lower than planned.
The airliner carried 20,400 pounds of fuel. That was less than half the amount needed, so the calculation mattered physically.
